description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for managing Telegram inline buttons related to model selection, including parsing callback data, building keyboards with pagination, and handling provider/model data.

methods.name: parseModelCallbackData
methods.description: Parses callback data string into a structured object representing the user action.

methods.name: buildModelSelectionCallbackData
methods.description: Constructs callback data string for model selection, using either standard or compact format.

methods.name: resolveModelSelection
methods.description: Resolves a model selection callback to a specific provider and model, handling ambiguity.

methods.name: buildProviderKeyboard
methods.description: Creates a keyboard layout with provider buttons, two per row.

methods.name: buildModelsKeyboard
methods.description: Creates a paginated keyboard for models with navigation and back buttons.

methods.name: buildBrowseProvidersButton
methods.description: Builds a button to browse providers.

methods.name: getModelsPageSize
methods.description: Returns the page size used for model list pagination.

methods.name: calculateTotalPages
methods.description: Calculates total number of pages for a list of models based on page size.
